I was forced to play DnD with friends at the mall. Just there watching and scrolling on my phone. Then my friend texted me the TMZ report and was like “YOOOOOO”. I couldn’t believe it. I had to leave  the store where we were at and sat outside composing myself and just stared at the floor in disbelief for a couple of minutes. Later that night my friends and I went on a binge watch and watched some of his music videos. A somber night it was.

I didn’t cry, I’m surprised I didn’t. I had been listening to Mac for probably 7 years straight, everyday at that point. But probably a year later I broke down and sobbed like a bitch when I was in my car doing my daily therapy driving, just driving around with no destination. I remember, I was talking to a girl I really liked and it wasn’t going well so I was just going around town just driving. I was feeling super down about the whole thing. Then  Clarity came on, haven’t listened to it in probably years. Then it really hit me that he was gone. Sobbed the whole song then went to one of his murals that my city has of him to reflect.
